about: Training packages the 4.0.1 environment reads from the GPU host's own Python environment instead of installing its own copy (torch there is the CUDA build, several GB). env/setup_mujoco_401.sh refuses to link them unless each version and the sha256 of its dist-info RECORD (the list of every installed file with its own hash) match. Recorded 2026-11-22. Only these five are checked; their own dependencies (sympy, protobuf, the CUDA wheels and so on) are not.
